title: Brown telescope map on shifted compact objects
statement: Let C be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] with Type v indexed coproducts and morphism universe v. Let I : Type v and E : I → C be compact objects [def-pc-compact-object]. Let H : C opposite → Ab be cohomological [def-sp-homological-functor; def-sp-abelian] and preserve all Type v indexed products. Then there exist G : C and a natural transformation α : Hom_C(-,G) → H such that α on E(i)[n] is an isomorphism for every i and integer n. Generation is not assumed, and no invertibility on arbitrary objects is concluded.

source.place: Tag 0A8F proof, generator coproducts, kernel-killing cones and telescope comparison

proof.text: Apply brownStageSequence to E and H to obtain a sequence with initial surjectivity on all E_i[n] and transitions killing the component kernels.
Apply brownTelescopeAssembly to the compatible sequence to obtain G, α, compatible stage maps ι_j, and factorization through a stage for every map from a shifted compact E_i.

Surjectivity of α on E_i[n] follows by lifting an H-element to the zeroth stage and composing with ι_0. For injectivity, subtract two maps with the same α-value and factor the difference as k followed by ι_j. Restriction compatibility shows β_j(k)=0. Kernel killing gives k followed by the successor transition equal to zero; stage-map compatibility then makes the original difference zero. A bijective morphism of abelian groups is an isomorphism, by ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective.
